Risk Description: Android 6 WebView 44 Incompatibility: Obsolete browser engine rejects modern ES6/CSS, breaking UI cards or crashing the mirror shell app.
Mitigation: Enforce strict ES5 transpile via Babel; use lightweight CSS2/3 flexbox subsets; test daily in Chromium 44 sandbox before glass deployment.
Trigger: Logcat records JS syntax error or card fails rendering on device.

Risk Description: Motion-to-Glass Latency Exceeds 250 ms Budget: Combined depth processing, avatar warp, and video encode creates noticeable interactive lag.
Mitigation: Use zero-copy shared memory (I7); drop resolution from 720p to 480p or fall back to 2D affine warping if frame processing time exceeds 20 ms.
Trigger: Telemetry watchdog reports frame pipeline latency > 220 ms across 10 consecutive frames.

Risk Description: Third-Party API Rate Limiting / Downtime: Weather or Google Calendar APIs throttle calls, alter schema, or experience outages during user morning routine.
Mitigation: Implement L7 stale-while-revalidate local cache (24h TTL) and default seasonal context bundles; decouple mirror wake flow from live network replies.
Trigger: L7 logs three consecutive HTTP 429 or 5xx responses from external endpoints.

Risk Description: Academic Exam & Senior Project Workload Imbalance: Midterm/final exam spikes cause sprint bottlenecks or delayed cross-module handoffs.
Mitigation: Schedule explicit 15-20% buffer on all tasks; lock in Spring Break as a zero-task recess; cross-train pairings (Rehman/Jace on bus, Arya/Clare on decision/try-on).
Trigger: Any task slips more than 4 calendar days beyond its planned start date.

Risk Description: Kinect 360 USB Isochronous Packet Drops: Linux USB 2.0 driver drops isochronous depth packets under CPU spikes, causing frame pipeline stall.
Mitigation: Assign real-time SCHED_FIFO priority to L1 Capture daemon; implement automated 2-second USB re-enumeration fallback in daemon.
Trigger: L1 emits capture.health = DOWN or no frame received for > 2000 ms.

Risk Description: Kinect Bracket Mechanical Drift: 3D-printed clip-over bracket flexes or slips, altering sensor pitch and distorting ground-truth height/chest calibration.
Mitigation: Print bracket with structural gusset in PETG; run 10-second reference plane calibration check against mirror frame during system startup.
Trigger: Extracted height or shoulder measurements deviate > 10% between consecutive sessions of same user.
